2026-10-27 (SCAN-1129 thread): first slice. 21 hand-rolled primary <button> class strings outside admin now use buttonClasses('primary', size) from the kit (connections, events, settings, spaces, claim and join pages, CRM capture). Remaining raw-button-bg sites are mostly selected-state toggle chips (bg-primary only when active), which need a kit segmented/chip control rather than a Button swap, plus admin files owned by the admin thread. Not re-frozen: the adoption counter needs Daniel to name it.

2026-10-26 bounded admin-control batch: Connection settings Save changes, page Layout editor Save, and Email Studio Loom photo Use/Remove actions now use shared buttonClasses primary/dangerOutline variants and small sizing. Four hand-rolled geometry/palette class strings are retired across three files. Explicit button/submit types, pending/loading/selection disabled guards, labels, callbacks and form structure are preserved. This is partial adoption; full button sweep and rendered visual acceptance remain open.
